content: MK says that Akram Jūdī-Niʿmatī, uniquely among scholars, attempts a preliminary evaluation of Ibn Turka's thought on the basis of his oeuvre as a whole, which MK says can only produce an image "very different from the caricature" offered so far.
refers_to_primary: Jūdī-Niʿmatī, introduction to Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr (2005)
